2. Not medical advice & who should take care (important)

MealPause is a wellbeing and intermittent-fasting tool. It provides general information and tracking — it does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and using it does not create any doctor–patient relationship. We are a technology provider, not a healthcare provider.

Fasting and dietary changes aren't right for everyone and can carry real risks. Please talk to a qualified health professional before starting or changing any fasting or eating routine. In particular, MealPause is not intended for people who:

  • have, or have had, an eating disorder (such as anorexia, bulimia, or orthorexia);
  • are underweight (BMI below 18.5);
  • are pregnant, breastfeeding, or trying to conceive;
  • are under 18 years of age;
  • have Type 1 diabetes or another condition needing strict dietary or glucose control — unless under direct medical supervision.

You use the App at your own risk and are responsible for your own health decisions. Stop and seek advice if you feel unwell. Any advanced metrics you log (glucose, ketones, electrolytes, body measurements) are for personal reference only — they are not medical monitoring, diagnosis, or alerts, and must not be used to make medical decisions.
